week.headline: The NFELO model and Vegas are 19.6 percentage points apart on Philadelphia at Washington.

rest.headline: San Francisco projects to 12.8 wins, the most in the league.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: Atlanta's playoff chances fell the most this week, to 23%. San Francisco is the Super Bowl favorite at 12%.
